card.title: Chain of Command
card.instruction: Treat every question, favor, and decision as something that must travel through the proper hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A teaspoon request goes through the kitchen supervisor, then catering.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then countersign your request. I'll pass it up to catering.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 establishes supervisor then catering, A3 rejects physical access as authorization, and A5 makes the supervisor role a formal step along that route.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's proximity challenge informs A3's distinction; B4's supervisor identity causes A5's countersignature and onward routing.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers the obvious practical solution and B4 supplies relevant authority.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's identity to advance the pre-established process without allowing direct utensil access.

specificity.evidence: A1 specifies the entire teaspoon hierarchy before B2 notes that the objects are at hand.
